Step 1) Make the base with a woke orb from a shaper and elder helm. Target helm must be ilvl 84+ blizzard or archdemon crown, donor needs to be minimum 84+ too Step 2) Spam Horror essences for Hypothermia (approx 1 in 25 for Level 16, 1 in 40 for Level 18, 1 in 75 for Level 20) Step 3) if no open suffix annul, if open suffix, Suffix's Cannot be changed, Reforge Crit at harvest bench, if hit spell crit good, if hit attack crit, annul Step 4) repeat step 2/3 until happy with suffixs, whatever tiers that looks like for you
^xE05030You can stop here and craft +1 aoe if youre out of currency.Next part can get pricey^xC8C8C8
Step 5) Version A: Suffix's Cannot Change, reforge influence looking for Conc Effect this is riskier since it can fill the prefixs, but often faster and cheaper Version B: block mana, slam slam looking for Conc Effect, if no conc, suffix cannot be changed, scour, repeat Step 6) if only conc effect prefix, craft suffix cannot be changed, Veiled exalt, if hit craft unveil after blocking minion helm craft (+1 Zombie/+1 Skelli) , if remove Conc, repeat step 5 Step 7) after unveiling +2 aoe, craft life

^x70FF70How to make basic (non elevated) boots^7 (rough cost 10-15d in 3.27)
1) get tailwind and onslaught on two seperate boots, either through alt/chaos spam, or buying them (must not have another influenced mod). tailwind is VERY hard to roll. buy it if you can 2) Use an awakeners orb on them, destroys the first item and keeps the second, so pick the base you want 3) if you have an open suffix, lock the suffixs and reforge fire/lighting. ^xAF6025Do not reforge cold/chaos as redeemer has cold prefixs and hunter has chaos prefixs^7, if no open suffix skip to step 4 4) craft suffixs cannot be changed, and reforge crit for elusive 5) craft suffixs cannot be changed and use a veiled exalted orb, if you lose elusive, reforge crit again and repeat 6) before unveiling craft life or mana to block, and take whatever movement speed you get 7 )bench craft another prefix of choice
^x70FF70Elevated boots^7 (rough cost 40-45d in 3.27)
1) get by rolling or buying, a boot with tailwind and another influenced mod, use an orb of dominance to elevate, if you miss, repeat, you can guarantee a second elvated mod if you have tailwind and full suffixs by crafting suffix cannot be changed and reforging chaos 2) repeat step 1 but with redeemer boots and the onslaught on kill mod, the second mod can be guaranteed with onslaught and full suffixs by crafting suffix cannot be changed and reforging crit 3a) use a awakeners orb on the first pair of boots and then the second pair of boots, whichever base you want to keep should be the second base,
3b) if you want to get a guaranteed res on them, the second base must be a blue magic item with the elevated mod, , this can be accomplished by having a single suffix (the elevated mod) and crafting suffix cannot be changed and scouring, then you use a craicic chimeral and a black morrigan to apply a hinekoras lock to them, click the awakeners orb on the first pair and ^x70FF70HOVER^7 the second pair (with the lock on it) see if you get a 3rd suffix you want,if you do then click. if you dont, use a chrome orb to reset the lock, and repeat this step until you get the suffix you want or will settle with
4) Craft suffix's cannot be changed, reforge crit for elusive 5) Craft suffixs cannot be changed, use a veiled exalt to add a veiled mod, if you lose the elusive, reforge crit and repeat this step 6) block life or mana before unveiling, and pick whatever movespeed you get 7) finish by crafting prefix of choice on the bench
